title: Precision landing — shortened by us
earthTestableComponent: Hazard-detection and terrain-relative-navigation tests over rough terrain at low sun angle.

toleranceSource.note: Moon south-pole envelope v0 (data/envelopes/moon-south-pole-v0.json). It covers both required dimensions: terrain (max slope over a 100 m baseline, 0-10 deg) and illumination (surface sunlit for the whole stay window, 100 percent). Citations are in data/envelopes/README.md.

notTestableOnEarth.why: Descent and touchdown dynamics depend on lunar gravity (about 0.17 g).
In vacuum, engine plumes blast the surface differently than in Earth's air.

title: Operate surface mobility systems (EVA suits, tools, vehicles) — shortened by us
earthTestableComponent: Traverse and EVA procedures on rough, dusty, unvegetated terrain.

toleranceSource.note: Mars reference envelope v0 (data/envelopes/mars-reference-v0.json). It covers terrain (mean slope along traverse corridors, 0-5 deg) and surfaceMaterial (albedo 0-0.25). thermal and dustProcess have no traceable range yet, so gate 2 (withinTolerance) is unknown for those two dimensions only. Citations and the reasons for the gaps are in data/envelopes/README.md.

notTestableOnEarth.why: Suit and vehicle dynamics change at Mars gravity (about 0.38 g).
Thin CO2 atmosphere changes dust charging, suit pressure and heat loss.

title: Characterize core frozen volatiles (permanently shadowed regions) — shortened by us
earthTestableComponent: Drilling and coring frozen ground in cold, dark conditions.

sources: docs/research/08-landing-site-feature-set.md (SE-3LM - PSR, cold-trap temperature, ice stability, neutron H)

toleranceSource.note: Moon south-pole envelope v0 (data/envelopes/moon-south-pole-v0.json). It covers waterIce (distance to nearest PSR, 0-2 km) and illumination (surface sunlit for the whole stay window, 100 percent). thermal and subsurface have no traceable bound yet, so gate 2 (withinTolerance) is unknown for those two dimensions only. Citations and the reasons for the two gaps are in data/envelopes/README.md.

notTestableOnEarth.why: In lunar vacuum, ice sublimates in ways Earth's air pressure can't reproduce.
Unshielded space radiation reaches the lunar surface; Earth's field and atmosphere block it.
